visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Filter Keeps Every Item
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Removing duplicates from [3,1,3,2,1,5] should give [3,1,2,5], but the program prints the array unchanged.

solution.explanation: indexOf returns the position of the first occurrence. An item is a first occurrence when that position equals its own index. Testing indexOf !== -1 is true for every item, because every item is in the list.
